findings.reason: A warranted explanatory omission under the expanded diagram scope: Verification 1.2 names I, X and E via an unspecified companion convention, while the reader has no picture connecting those names to the three distinct matching basis vectors. Displaying the endomorphism matchings and their actions materially clarifies the representation sign convention and the distinction between a nonzero free-algebra element and its zero image. The existing proof is complete and remains independent.
findings.action: Added a final Remarks section displaying the identity, crossing and cup-cap matchings with their three tensor actions, plus an explicitly representation-level zero relation.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: Each panel is a basis matching in B_2(-2)=B_{-2}(2,2): two ordered top inputs and two ordered bottom outputs. The displayed action rho maps B_2(-2) into End_Q(V tensor V), with V=Q^2 and the original alternating form omega.
diagram_math_checks.justification: The local definition def-brauer-and-partition-diagram-categories defines top inputs, bottom outputs and the free matching basis. The original Example and Verification 1.2 specify this V, omega and the action.

diagram_math_checks.relation: I joins input 1 to output 1 and input 2 to output 2; X joins input 1 to output 2 and input 2 to output 1; E pairs the two inputs and the two outputs separately.
diagram_math_checks.check: Each panel has precisely four endpoint vertices of degree one and two edges; the central crossing of X is not a vertex. E has two disjoint arcs and no loop. These are the three distinct matchings counted in F1 and Verification 2.1.

diagram_math_checks.relation: rho(I)=id, rho(X)=-P and rho(E)=c omega, where P(v tensor w)=w tensor v and c=-e1 tensor e2+e2 tensor e1.
diagram_math_checks.check: These are exactly the assignments in Verification 1.2; the caption specifies the domains by giving each operator on V tensor V. The cup-cap maps a tensor to omega(v,w)c. No orientation arrows or over/under knot crossing are asserted.

diagram_math_checks.relation: rho(I)+rho(X)+rho(E)=0, while I+X+E is nonzero in the free algebra.
diagram_math_checks.check: Independently on e1 tensor e1 and e2 tensor e2, id-P is zero and omega is zero. On e1 tensor e2, (id-P) gives e1 tensor e2-e2 tensor e1=-c, and omega=1, so adding c omega gives zero. On e2 tensor e1, (id-P)=c and omega=-1, again zero. Nonzero free-algebra sum follows from three distinct basis vectors with nonzero coefficients, as F1 and Verification 2.1 state. The illustration never equates the abstract sum to zero or conflates it with the alternating four-vector boundary-order formula.
